properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Simulator TLS key material hardcoded by design: chia/simulator/ssl_certs_*.py embed PEM private keys (test CA plus fullnode/wallet/farmer/harvester service identity certs) so the local simulator ships working TLS with no setup step. Real key material, but test-only infrastructure, committed deliberately for reproducibility — not production secrets. CWE-321-class exposure is intentional and scoped to the simulator.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: check_hostname=False on both the client and server ssl contexts (chia/server/server.py:68/98) for the node-to-node interconnection protocol: peer identity is the pinned CA plus CERT_REQUIRED mutual auth (set at lines 71/100), not DNS names — peers dial raw IPs with self-generated certificates, so hostname checking is inapplicable rather than weakened. Deliberate mTLS posture, not a bypass.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Python random module usage confined to benchmarks/ and chia/_tests (all 96 sites sampled across 4 pages): benchmark fixture data, seeded test determinism, random test blobs/sleeps. No key material, nonces, or security-relevant decisions derive from these — CSPRNGs (os.urandom/secrets) are used where randomness matters. Weak-PRNG detector hit on test code, kept with scope noted.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA-2048 private-key generation (public_exponent 65537) for the node's own CA root key (create_ssl.py:108) and leaf certificate key (create_ssl.py:73) — mints the TLS identities used by daemon/full_node/wallet/harvester/farmer. Shor-vulnerable; migration path is PQ/hybrid certificates. Key size 2048 is adequate classically (not undersized). Remaining sites are the pyca/cryptography dependency declarations in poetry.lock that provide RSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 here is the authenticator half of the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD at file_keyring.py:56/62 — identical call sites to the ChaCha20-Poly1305 object; one logical asset, two names.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Daemon RPC TLS 1.2 cipher list (chia/daemon/server.py:218-229) explicitly pins ten ECDHE-* suites (ECDHE-ECDSA/ECDHE-RSA with AES-256-GCM, AES-128-GCM, CHACHA20-POLY1305, and CBC SHA384/SHA256 suites). ECDHE key agreement is Shor-vulnerable — harvest-now-decrypt-later applies to daemon-to-client RPC traffic. Migration: TLS 1.3 with hybrid X25519MLKEM768 once the linked OpenSSL supports it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDHE-ECDSA-* suites configured in the daemon TLS 1.2 cipher list (chia/daemon/server.py:220/222/224/226/228) — effectively dormant since create_ssl.py mints RSA-keyed certs, but configured capability nonetheless. Plus the pyca/cryptography dependency (poetry.lock) providing ECDSA. ECDSA is Shor-vulnerable; migration is hybrid ML-DSA/SLH-DSA certificates.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: verify_mode=CERT_REQUIRED on both interconnection ssl contexts — node-to-node traffic is mutual TLS under the pinned CA. Strong posture; the quantum exposure of this protocol sits in the ECDHE handshake and cert key material, not this setting.
